decisions.headline: 《战争机器：事变日》联动 Liquid Death，9月25日至11月30日提供 Chainsaw Flex 姿势奖励
decisions.summary: Xbox Wire 公布《战争机器：事变日》与 Liquid Death 的联动活动：美国地区玩家在9月25日至11月30日期间通过指定零售渠道购买 Liquid Death Energy，可解锁以 Chainsaw Flex 传奇动画姿势为主的游戏内容包；同日还推出限量联名周边。
decisions.verification: Xbox Wire 一手页面已打开；活动时间、美国地区限制、指定购买方式与 Chainsaw Flex 奖励均按原文呈现。
decisions.reason: 窗口内的一手联动公告，主体、活动期与奖励边界明确。
decisions.timeNote: Xbox Wire 页面发布时间换算为北京时间9月26日00:00，位于本期固定窗口内。

decisions.titleZhCn: 空战奇兵8 希孚之翼
decisions.headline: 《空战奇兵8 希孚之翼》公开前10个战役任务体验：四类机体与小队协同成核心
decisions.summary: Xbox Wire 在试玩前10个战役任务后介绍《空战奇兵8 希孚之翼》：机体分为 Fighter、Multirole、Attacker 与 Electronic Warfare 四类，任务涵盖护航、轰炸与空战等类型，并提供逐级训练任务；Joker Flight 小队成员也会在战斗中协助完成目标。Xbox Series X|S 版文章标注10月2日推出。
decisions.verification: Xbox Wire 一手试玩稿已打开；仅采用文章明确陈述的前10个战役任务体验、四类机体、训练任务、小队协同与 Xbox Series X|S 上线日期，不将作者评价写成客观结论。
decisions.reason: 窗口内的一手深度试玩，提供了明确的新系统与战役信息增量。
decisions.timeNote: Xbox Wire 页面发布时间换算为北京时间9月25日22:30，位于本期固定窗口内。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | ACE COMBAT 8 details its first 10 campaign missions

entries.headline: Gears of War: E-Day teams with Liquid Death for a Chainsaw Flex reward running September 25 to November 30
entries.summary: Xbox Wire announced a Gears of War: E-Day collaboration with Liquid Death. In the United States, eligible Liquid Death Energy purchases through participating retailers from September 25 through November 30 can unlock an in-game content pack headlined by the Legendary animated Chainsaw Flex pose; limited collaboration merchandise also launched the same day.
entries.verification: The Xbox Wire primary page was opened. The campaign dates, U.S.-only restriction, purchase path and Chainsaw Flex reward are bounded to that source.
entries.timeNote: The Xbox Wire publication time converts to 00:00 Beijing time on September 26, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: ACE COMBAT 8 details its first 10 campaign missions, four aircraft roles and squad support
entries.summary: After playing the first 10 campaign missions, Xbox Wire described four aircraft roles—Fighter, Multirole, Attacker and Electronic Warfare—alongside escort, bombing and air-to-air missions, progressive training missions and combat support from Joker Flight. The article lists an October 2 launch for Xbox Series X|S.
entries.verification: The Xbox Wire primary hands-on article was opened. This copy uses only its concrete campaign, aircraft-role, training, squad-support and Xbox Series X|S release-date details, not the author's qualitative verdicts.
entries.timeNote: The Xbox Wire publication time converts to 22:30 Beijing time on September 25, inside this edition's fixed window.
